title: Growth of the Undrawn Summit Line — Training Questions and Answers
content:
**Rule.** The undrawn line of a Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage grows monthly at one twelfth of the plan's fixed line growth rate, independent of the note rate, on the line at the end of the month, posted on the plan's interest posting day of the following month and rounded half up to the cent. Summit line growth is credited only while the loan status is active. A plan whose growth rate is 0.00 never earns growth.

**What grows?** The undrawn line available for draws — not the loan balance.

**At what rate?** At the plan's own fixed annual growth rate, divided over twelve months. The rate does not follow the note rate: a change in the note rate of an adjustable plan leaves the growth rate untouched.

**On what amount?** On the undrawn line standing at the end of the month. The month's growth is that line multiplied by the plan's growth rate in percent, divided by 1200, rounded half up to the cent.

**When is it posted?** On the posting day of the following month.

**In which status?** Only while the loan is active. A loan in its rescission period, with its draw period expired, due and payable, paid in full, liquidated or rescinded earns no growth.

**Which plans never grow?** A plan whose growth rate is 0.00. That includes the plans without a line — the Summit Fixed Lump Sum and the Summit Second Lien — and the Summit Flex Fixed.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** An active Summit Estate Line loan with, for illustration, USD 184306.55 of undrawn line at the end of a month earns that amount multiplied by its growth rate of 4.25, divided by 1200 — USD 652.75231 before rounding — and USD 652.75 is credited to the line on the posting day of the following month. The same line on a Summit Flex Fixed loan earns nothing, its growth rate being 0.00.
